app.name: Daftari
app.tagline: You speak. Daftari remembers. You stay in control.
app.description: Voice-first bookkeeping for your business. Speak, then review and confirm.
app.stale: This data may be out of date
signin.title: Sign in to Daftari
signin.subtitle: Voice-first bookkeeping for Tanzanian small businesses.
signin.benefit1: Record a voice note in Daftari
signin.benefit2: Daftari writes down what it hears
signin.benefit3: You confirm before anything is recorded
signin.devNotice: Development build: accounts are seeded locally.
signin.failed: Could not sign in. Please try again.
signin.switchLabel: Sign in or create an account
signin.signInSubtitle: Enter your details to open your dashboard.
signin.createSubtitle: One account per business. You can invite your team later.
signin.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.
signin.error.emailInvalid: Enter an email address like name@business.co.tz.
signin.error.emailTaken: An account already uses that email address.
signin.error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
signin.error.network: We could not reach Daftari. Check your connection and try again.
app.errorBody: Daftari could not load this page. Try again, and if it keeps failing contact support.
app.notFoundBody: The page you asked for does not exist or has moved.
onboarding.title: Set up your business
onboarding.businessTypeHint: Choose the closest option. You can change this later.
onboarding.consentBody: When you send a voice note or business message to the Daftari number, Daftari stores the message, transcribes your voice, and prepares record proposals for you to review. Audio and transcripts are private business data. You can change this any time in Settings.
onboarding.consentCheckbox: I understand and allow Daftari to process my WhatsApp messages as described.
onboarding.connectBody: Daftari only accepts events for a number you connect here. Status is confirmed by Daftari, never assumed.
onboarding.teamBody: Team members can help review records. Staff do not see owner-level money by default.
onboarding.teamInviteHint: Seeded accounts are invited by name in this build.
onboarding.nextBody: Open WhatsApp, send a short voice note to the Daftari number, for example: "Today I sold rice for 15,000 and M-Pesa paid 10,000, the rest is deni."
overview.pageIntro: Here’s what is happening in your business.
overview.subtitle: Confirmed records only. {count} records in this period.
overview.reviewCardBody: Check the source and details before anything is added to your records.
overview.reviewClearBody: New recordings will appear here for confirmation.
overview.kpi.heading: Business totals
overview.kpi.salesReceivedCalc: Confirmed sales marked as paid, plus confirmed debt payments received in {period}. Pending proposals are excluded.
overview.kpi.expensesCalc: Confirmed expenses in {period}. Pending proposals, voided and reversed records are excluded.
overview.kpi.netCalc: Sales received minus expenses. This is cash movement, not accounting profit.
overview.kpi.deniCalc: Confirmed debts that are still open. It may not match your bank or mobile-money balance.
overview.kpi.deniUnavailable: Deni is not enabled for this business.
overview.kpi.noComparison: No comparison shown: the previous period has too few confirmed records.
overview.chart.title: Money in and out
overview.chart.description: Confirmed sales received and expenses per {granularity}.
overview.recent.title: Recent confirmed records
overview.recent.subtitle: Your latest activity, with its source.
overview.insight.title: What stands out
overview.insight.salesUp: Sales received were higher than your usual for this time of day.
overview.insight.expenseSpike: Expenses were higher than usual this period.
overview.insight.deniGrowing: Money owed to you grew this period.
overview.inventoryCardBody: {count} items are at or below your low-stock level.
overview.empty.title: No confirmed records yet
overview.empty.periodTitle: No confirmed records in this period
overview.empty.body: Record a voice note to start. Daftari will prepare a record for you to confirm.
overview.empty.cta: See how to send a voice note
overview.noRecordsInPeriod: No confirmed records in this period
overview.staleBanner: Last updated {when}. Newer recordings may not be included yet.
overview.period.label: Showing
dashboard.signInRequiredBody: Sign in to see your business records and review activity.
dashboard.sessionUnavailable: Your session could not be checked. Refresh and try again.
record.title: Record a voice note
record.subtitle: Speak naturally in Swahili or English. Daftari saves the audio and writes down what it hears for you to check.
record.hint: Tip: mention what happened, the amount, and who it was with.
record.savedBody: Daftari is writing it down. Open Review to check and complete it.
record.micDenied: Microphone access is needed to record. Allow it in your browser and try again.
record.unsupported: This browser cannot record audio. Try Chrome, Edge or Safari on a phone.
record.failed: The recording could not be saved. Try again.
record.retryHint: Your recording is kept on this device. Trying again will not create a duplicate.
record.privacy: Your recording is sent securely to Daftari and turned into a draft. Nothing is added to your records until you confirm it.
review.title: Review
review.subtitle: Daftari's proposals need a decision before they count.
review.empty.title: Nothing to review
review.empty.body: Proposals appear here when Daftari finishes reading a recording. Nothing is recorded without your confirmation.
review.noMatch.title: No proposals match these filters
review.noMatch.body: Clear the filters to see the rest of the queue.
review.queue.stale: The queue may be out of date. Refresh to see new proposals.
review.transcriptPendingBody: Daftari is still listening to this message. You can come back later.
review.transcriptFailed: Daftari could not transcribe this message
review.processing: Daftari is still preparing the proposal
review.retryQueued: Processing restarted. The proposal will refresh shortly.
reviewDetail.title: Review proposal
reviewDetail.editHint: Correct anything Daftari misunderstood. Nothing is recorded until you confirm.
reviewDetail.sourcePrivacy: Source messages and transcripts are private business data.
reviewDetail.audioUnavailable: Audio is no longer available for this message.
reviewDetail.audioUnavailableRetention: Audio is kept for {days} days, then deleted automatically.
reviewDetail.reclassifyHint: Daftari saved your recording without guessing what it is. Choose the type, then fill in the details.
reviewDetail.missingField: Daftari could not hear this clearly
reviewDetail.confirmEffect.sale: Add a sale of {amount} to confirmed records
reviewDetail.confirmEffect.expense: Add an expense of {amount} to confirmed records
reviewDetail.confirmEffect.debt_payment: Record {amount} received from {customer} as a deni payment
reviewDetail.confirmEffect.stock_movemen: Record a stock movement of {quantity} {unit} for {item}
reviewDetail.confirmEffect.note: Save this as a business note
reviewDetail.confirmedBody: It now counts in your totals and appears in Records.
reviewDetail.rejectedBody: The message is kept with your reason.
reviewDetail.rejectNoteHint: A short note helps support. It is stored with the decision.
reviewDetail.duplicateBody: Daftari found a confirmed record with a similar amount and time. Compare them before confirming.
reviewDetail.conflictBody: This proposal was updated by {actor} while you were reviewing. Reload to see the newer version.
reviewDetail.permissionDenied: Your role cannot decide on proposals.
reviewDetail.saveFailed: Could not save your changes. They are still on screen.
reviewDetail.validation.invalidDate: Choose a valid date and time
reviewDetail.validation.quantityInvalid: Enter a quantity with up to 3 decimal places
records.title: Records
records.subtitle: Confirmed records. Corrections are tracked, never erased.
records.empty.title: No confirmed records yet
records.empty.body: Once you confirm a proposal, it appears here with its source.
records.noMatch.title: No records match these filters
records.detail.title: Record
records.detail.voidWarning: Voiding keeps the record and its history but removes it from totals.
records.detail.reverseWarning: Reversing creates an opposite record and links it to the original.
records.detail.reasonHint: Required. Stored with before and after values.
records.detail.cannotDelete: Confirmed records cannot be deleted. Correct, void or reverse them instead.
deni.title: People who owe you
deni.subtitle: From confirmed records only. It may not match your bank or mobile-money balance.
deni.empty.title: No open debts
deni.empty.body: When you confirm a sale as deni, the customer appears here.
deni.noMatch.title: No customers match this search
deni.customer.title: {name}
deni.customer.reminderUnavailable: Sending reminders is not available yet. Copy the text and send it yourself.
deni.customer.overpaymentWarning: This is more than the open balance. The extra stays as a credit on the customer.
inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: Stock on hand from confirmed movements.
inventory.empty.title: No items yet
inventory.empty.body: Add items with their units so Daftari can track stock movements.
inventory.gated.title: Inventory is not enabled
inventory.gated.body: Turn on inventory once your items and units are set up. Stock changes from voice notes stay proposals until you confirm them.
inventory.notInferred: Daftari does not guess stock counts from a sale unless the item and quantity were clear.
inventory.form.name: Item name
reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Summaries from confirmed records. Not tax-ready statements.
reports.salesExpenses.title: Sales and expenses
reports.cash.title: Cash movement
reports.deni.title: Deni
reports.categories.title: By category
reports.export.expired: This download expired. Request a new one.
reports.export.failed: The export could not be built
reports.inclusionRules.body: Confirmed records only, between {from} and {to}, in business timezone {timezone}. Pending proposals, voided and reversed records are excluded. Figures are cash movement, not accounting profit or tax.
reports.incompleteNotice: Coverage is incomplete if some messages were not processed or are still waiting for review.
settings.title: Settings
settings.pageIntro: Manage your account and the business workspace you are using.
settings.session.title: Session
settings.session.signedOut: You are not signed in. Use the local development sign-in below to create or open a workspace.
settings.devLogin.title: Local development sign-in
settings.devLogin.body: This option is only available when local developer sign-in is enabled. It is not an identity flow for production.
settings.devLogin.name: Your name
settings.devLogin.subject: Developer account ID
settings.subtitle: Business, connections, team and privacy.
settings.whatsapp.reconnectSteps: To reconnect: open WhatsApp Business, link the number again, then return here. No records are lost.
settings.whatsapp.disconnectWarning: Disconnecting stops new WhatsApp messages from becoming proposals. Existing records stay.
settings.whatsapp.noSecrets: Provider credentials are never shown here.
settings.team.removeWarning: Removing a member stops their access immediately. Their past decisions stay in history.
settings.team.permissionDenied: Only the owner can manage the team.
settings.team.ownerWarning: A business keeps at least one owner.
settings.privacy.retentionBody: Audio is deleted automatically after this period. Confirmed records and audit history are kept because they are your business history.
settings.privacy.exportRequestBody: We prepare a copy of your business data and send the download link.
settings.privacy.deletionRequestBody: Deletion follows legal retention duties. Audit history and backups may be kept for a period, so some data is not erased immediately.
settings.privacy.analyticsOptInBody: Event names and counts only. Never transcripts, amounts, customer names or phone numbers.
settings.privacy.requestNote: This is a development build. No request is sent to a support team; the event is recorded in your audit history.
settings.notifications.newProposals: Tell me when new proposals arrive
settings.security.passwordless: Passwordless sign-in with your phone number
settings.security.identityNote: A managed identity provider verifies sign-in. This build uses seeded local accounts.
settings.support.helpBody: Answers about records, deni and voice notes.
settings.support.contactBody: Include your business name and the source ID if you report a problem with a message.
settings.feature.inventoryBody: Show stock levels from confirmed movements.
settings.feature.manualEntriesBody: Allow records typed at a computer. They are marked as manual.
dateRange.label: Date range
state.empty.title: Nothing here yet
state.error.title: We could not load this
state.error.body: Nothing was changed. Try again, and contact support if it keeps failing.
state.permission.title: You do not have access to this
state.permission.body: Ask the business owner for access.
state.conflict.title: Someone else changed this
state.conflict.body: Reload to see the latest version.
manualEntry.title: Add a record manually
manualEntry.body: Use this only when you are at a computer. Records are marked as manual.
dev.title: Developer tools
dev.simulate: Simulate an inbound WhatsApp voice note
dev.simulateHint: Development only. Sends a signed webhook through the provider adapter, then runs the pipeline.
dev.personaHint: Seeded accounts for checking role permissions.
dev.failed: The simulated message failed. Check the queue.
